metadata.name: 雅思词汇库
metadata.description: IELTS 雅思考试核心词汇 - 内置高质量词汇

words.definition: Relating to education and scholarship
words.example: She has an academic background in linguistics.

words.definition: The subjects comprising a course of study
words.example: The new curriculum includes more practical skills.

words.definition: A system of methods used in a particular area of study
words.example: The research methodology was clearly explained.

words.definition: A supposition or proposed explanation
words.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis through experiments.

words.definition: Detailed examination of the elements or structure
words.example: The analysis revealed interesting patterns in the data.

words.definition: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level
words.example: We need sustainable energy sources for the future.

words.definition: The variety of plant and animal life
words.example: The rainforest has incredible biodiversity.

words.definition: A biological community of interacting organisms
words.example: The coral reef ecosystem is very fragile.

words.definition: The protection of plants, animals, and natural areas
words.example: Wildlife conservation is crucial for future generations.

words.definition: Not depleted when used
words.example: Solar power is a renewable energy source.

words.definition: The action or process of innovating
words.example: Technological innovation drives economic growth.

words.definition: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally
words.example: Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.

words.definition: The use of largely automatic equipment
words.example: Factory automation has increased productivity.

words.definition: Relating to computer technology
words.example: The digital revolution changed how we communicate.

words.definition: A process or set of rules to be followed
words.example: The search algorithm finds relevant results quickly.

words.definition: The state of being diverse; variety
words.example: Cultural diversity enriches our society.

words.definition: The process by which businesses develop international influence
words.example: Globalization has connected markets worldwide.

words.definition: The process of making an area more urban
words.example: Rapid urbanization has created megacities.

words.definition: Relating to the structure of populations
words.example: Demographic changes affect economic planning.

words.definition: Relating to several cultural groups
words.example: Australia is a multicultural society.

words.definition: Relating to medicinal drugs
words.example: The pharmaceutical industry develops new treatments.

words.definition: A widespread occurrence of an infectious disease
words.example: The flu epidemic affected thousands of people.

words.definition: The process of providing food necessary for health
words.example: Good nutrition is essential for children's development.

words.definition: Treatment intended to relieve or heal a disorder
words.example: Physical therapy helped her recover from the injury.

words.definition: The identification of the nature of an illness
words.example: Early diagnosis improves treatment outcomes.

words.definition: A person who organizes and operates a business
words.example: The young entrepreneur started three successful companies.

words.definition: The action of investing money for profit
words.example: Foreign investment boosted the local economy.

words.definition: The basic physical systems of a country or organization
words.example: Good infrastructure attracts business investment.

words.definition: A period of temporary economic decline
words.example: The recession led to higher unemployment rates.

words.definition: A raw material or primary agricultural product
words.example: Oil is an important global commodity.

words.definition: The activity of writing for newspapers or magazines
words.example: Investigative journalism exposed the corruption scandal.

words.definition: Transmit a programme on television or radio
words.example: The news was broadcast live from the scene.

words.definition: Information used to promote a political cause
words.example: The government used propaganda to influence public opinion.

words.definition: The suppression of speech or information
words.example: Internet censorship limits access to information.

words.definition: A film or television programme that provides factual information
words.example: The documentary explored climate change issues.
